messages.content: Decompose and delegate as parallel subtasks: produce two short (~60 word) analyses to support our Director model decision - (1) a COST analysis and (2) a LATENCY analysis comparing Claude Haiku vs Sonnet. Create ONE parent coordinator task, then TWO researcher-owned subtasks (one per analysis), each writing its own file under team/drafts/. Do not do the analyses yourself; delegate them to researchers.
